# Button

Starts an action or, as a button-link, goes to a page that continues the task.

- Status: implemented
- Category: action
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “button”; HTML `<button type="button"> or <a> for navigation`
- Text style: `body` (`.nd-text-body`)

## Anatomy

- **container**: The target: at least the minimum target size, padding from the size.
- **label**: A verb or a destination; never only an icon unless it has an accessible name.
- **icon** (optional): Leading or trailing; the forward arrow turns with the reading direction.

## Variants

- `primary`: The direction's fill: the one main action of a view.
- `secondary`: Outline in the direction's colour, text in the page colour .
- `quiet`: Underlined text action for minor actions.

Sizes: `md`, `lg`.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `active`
- `focus-visible`: The global ring: 2 px outline, 2 px gap, focus.ring colour.
- `disabled`: Dashed hollow outline and tertiary text; not colour alone.
- `pending`: Keeps its label, adds a turning mark (dotted and still under reduced motion) and aria-busy; a status region announces the outcome.

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter, Space | Activates the button. |
| Enter | Follows a button-link. |

## Accessibility

- Role: button (link for a button-link)
- Name: Its text; an icon-only button has aria-label.
- Prefer aria-disabled with an explanation over removing a control from the tab order.
- A destructive action names what it destroys.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.1.1 Keyboard (A)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA)
- 2.5.3 Label in Name (A)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | button.nd-button / a.nd-button |
| ios | Button with a ButtonStyle drawing button.* colours |
| android | Button, OutlinedButton, TextButton (Material 3 mapped by NDDevTheme) |
| flutter | FilledButton, OutlinedButton, TextButton |

Web: `.nd-button` in kit.css; modifiers `.nd-button--secondary`, `.nd-button--quiet`, `.nd-button--large`, `.nd-button--block`.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-cluster">
  <button type="button" class="nd-button">Primary</button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-button nd-button--secondary">
    Secondary
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-button nd-button--quiet">Quiet</button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-button nd-button--large">
    Large
    <svg
      class="nd-icon nd-icon--forward"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
    >
      <path
        d="M12 4.5 6.3 10.2l1.2 1.2 3.6-3.6v12h1.8v-12l3.6 3.6 1.2-1.2z"
        fill="currentColor"
      />
    </svg>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-button" disabled>Disabled</button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-button" aria-disabled="true">
    Unavailable
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="nd-button" aria-busy="true">Sending</button>
  <a class="nd-button nd-button--secondary" href="#button">Button link</a>
</div>
```
